entities.summary: Hupa is an extinct Athabaskan language spoken along the lower course of the Trinity River in Northwestern California by the Hoopa Valley Hupa and Tsnungwe/South Fork Hupa and, before European contact, by the Chilula and Whilkut peoples, to the west.
